subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is Bequille.
 
• The correct spelling is** 'Beguile'**.
 
• The word **"beguile"** means to deceive, charm or enchant someone in a way that may be misleading or dishonest. It can also mean to distract or divert someone's attention from something important.
 
 
• ***Example: **The salesman **beguiled **the elderly couple into buying an expensive vacuum cleaner by demonstrating its features and benefits, even though they didn't really need it.*
 
 
 
• Thus the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blandishment **means a **charming or appealing remark or action used to subtly persuade someone to take a certain action.**
 
• The word** "bereft" **means to be deprived or lacking something that is considered important or necessary. 
 
• The word **"assiduous" **means to be persistent, diligent, and hardworking in carrying out a task or duty.
